about: 2-fer areas for the KPC 2-fer bot (kpc-fers.yml), Nov 9 2026 (Brandon t905u: 'I just want to get through with them get a good run on all that'; regions are fine). Every US state and Canadian province is in exactly one area (Kentucky is its own run: region 'ky'). Each area is about 400-1,600 parks with an official outline, small enough to finish in one job. Pick one or more by name in the 'region' box, or 'areas' for all of them (3 at a time). An area that runs out of time keeps its previous files; run it again by name.
full_cycle_about: Nov 9 2026 (Brandon t917u 4:42 PM CST: 'an occasional full rebuild of one state or region is OK, but not all the time. KISS'; t918u 4:45 PM CST confirmed the 3-month default): every area gets ONE full rebuild (every pair tested again, KPC_FERS_FULL=1) per this many days, round-robin, oldest first. A run does the areas that are due, at most ceil(areas x 30 / full_cycle_days) of them (14 areas, 90 days -> 5 a monthly run). The rest of each run only re-tests what changed. Last full rebuild per area: data/fers/full-rebuild-<area>.txt (its date).
